p.p1 {margin: 0.0px 0.0px 0.0px 0.0px; font: 13.0px 'Helvetica Neue'}Brand-New Waterfront Luxury Living at Aire East – 305-777 Harbour Way, North Vancouver  Experience elevated waterfront living in this brand-new 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence at Aire East at North Harbour. Located on the 3rd floor, this beautifully designed home combines luxury finishes, modern comfort, and spectacular views in one of North Vancouver’s newest waterfront communities. One of the most impressive features of this residence is the exceptionally large, approximately 600 sq. ft. private balcony, offering beautiful views toward Downtown Vancouver. With plenty of space for outdoor seating, dining, and entertaining, this expansive balcony creates an incredible extension of the indoor living area and is perfect for enjoying the scenery and waterfront lifestyle.Inside, the bright and spacious open-concept floor plan features floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing an abundance of natural light throughout the home. The residence is finished with engineered hardwood flooring, central air conditioning, and a generous living and dining area designed for both entertaining and everyday comfort.
